outcome: fetal-origin cell prevalence in maternal buffy coat
fetal-origin cell quantity in maternal buffy coat
cohort: The study included 118 normotensive, clinically uncomplicated pregnancies at term (37+1 to 42+2 weeks' gestation) pre-delivery.
finding: Placental dysfunction, evidenced by increased gestational age, decreased PlGF, increased sFlt-1, and an increased sFlt-1/PlGF ratio, correlates with an increase in circulating fetal-origin cell prevalence and/or quantity in maternal circulation.
